frozen: Committed before any reading by the scanner; to be read once on the final cycle-4 code. Real photographs, too few for an accuracy estimate.
transcription: Found and transcribed by one search agent, then checked by eye on full-resolution crops by a second pass (this work); amount = volume x unit price where the price is shown. Not double-checked by a person. The currency word list (identity.ts) was extended with dirhams and other names after these photos were found and before they were read.
acquisition: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Petrol stations in Israel to depth 3, 187 files; Hebrew and English searches) and Flickr (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, PDM). Only three Israeli displays had every digit of amount and volume certain. Commons and Flickr are effectively exhausted for this target.
